title: Firewall: Playmaker's Deck (lore build)
summary: Firewall is Playmaker's (Yusaku Fujiki's) ace line in Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS. This lore build pairs the 2023 Firewall Main Deck engine (Firewall Defenser, Firewall Phantom, Firewall Guardian) with Playmaker's Cyberse extenders, Cynet Spells and Traps, and every Firewall Extra Deck evolution.

summary.title: Starters & Who's in it
points: Firewall Defenser and Firewall Phantom (2023 Cyberstorm Access support) trigger when sent to the GY as Link Material for a Cyberse monster: Defenser Special Summons another Firewall monster from the Deck, and Phantom searches any Cynet Spell or Trap.
Cynet Mining discards 1 card (such as Dotscaper, which immediately revives itself) to search any Level 4 or lower Cyberse starter, including Firewall Defenser, Clock Wyvern, or Cyberse Gadget.

Playmaker's anime Cyberse crew—Backup Secretary, Clock Wyvern, Widget Kid, Cyberse White Hat, Degrade Buster, Dotscaper, ROM Cloudia, Cyberse Gadget, and Cyberse Synchron—flood the board with Link materials.

summary.title: Opening: Firewall Defenser + Extender
steps: Normal Summon Firewall Defenser and Link Summon Link Spider or pair it with an extender (Backup Secretary or Dotscaper) into Cyberse Wicckid or Proxy Dragon.

Trigger Firewall Defenser in the GY to Special Summon Firewall Phantom from the Deck; link into a Cyberse Link Monster to trigger Firewall Phantom, searching Cynet Ritual, Cynet Fusion, or Cynet Circuit.

Use Cyberse Wicckid (banishing a GY Cyberse) to search Cyberse Synchron, then summon Cyberse Synchron + a Level 4/3 body to Synchro Summon Level 7 Firewall Saber Dragon (which revives a Cyberse from the GY to extend further).
Climb into Link-5 Firewall Dragon Darkfluid, Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz, or Link-6 Firewall Dragon Singularity with multiple summoning types loaded in your GY.

summary.title: Multi-Mechanic Counter Scaling
summary.text: Playmaker's high-Link bosses—Firewall Dragon Darkfluid and Firewall Dragon Singularity—scale directly with the number of different Cyberse summoning mechanics (Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz) on your field or in your GY. This build includes one of each: Cyberse Magician (Ritual via Cynet Ritual), Cyberse Clock Dragon (Fusion via Cynet Fusion), Firewall Saber Dragon (Synchro via Cyberse Synchron), and Firewall eXceed Dragon (Rank 4 Xyz).

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Firewall Dragon Singularity (Link-6) returns opponent's cards on the field or in the GY to the hand as a Quick Effect up to the number of different monster types (Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz) in your field and GY, gains 500 ATK for each, and revives a Cyberse when a monster it points to leaves the field.

Firewall Dragon Darkfluid gains a counter on Link Summon for each Cyberse Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz in your GY and removes a counter as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's monster effect, while Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz dumps a Cyberse from Deck/Extra Deck to gain its Attribute and 2500 ATK.
Firewall Dragon bounces monsters on the field or GY up to the number of monsters co-linked to it as a Quick Effect, and Decode Talker negates targeting effects.
Note: Firewall Defenser's Deck summon locks you into Cyberse monsters for the entire turn.

summary.title: Cynet Spells & Traps
points: Cynet Fusion Fusion Summons Cyberse Clock Dragon (using a Link Monster in your GY as material when you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone), and Cynet Ritual Ritual Summons Cyberse Magician before banishing itself from the GY to spawn two Cynet Tokens.

Cynet Backdoor banishes a Cyberse you control to search a Cyberse with lower ATK, returning the banished monster next Standby Phase able to attack directly, while Cynet Universe boosts Link Monsters by 300 ATK and recycles a GY monster.
Cynet Circuit Special Summons monsters from your GY to zones a Firewall Link Monster points to when it is Link Summoned, and revives a Firewall Link Monster when your LP drops to 2000 or less.

As Cyberse Link material, searches a Cynet Spell/Trap; recycles a Cyberse.

Returns after being Link material; stops a Link-on-Link attack.
Backup Secretary
Summons itself while you control a Cyberse.
Clock Wyvern
Halves its ATK for a Clock Token; Cyberse Clock Dragon material.
Widget Kid
Summons a Cyberse from the hand when summoned.
Cyberse White Hat
Summons itself next to two same-Type monsters; shrinks theirs as Link material.
Degrade Buster
Banishes two Cyberse from the GY to summon itself; banishes a bigger monster.
Dotscaper
Returns when sent to the GY or banished.
ROM Cloudia
Recovers a Cyberse; calls one from the Deck when destroyed.
Cyberse Gadget
Revives a Level 2 or lower; leaves a Gadget Token.
Cyberse Synchron
Tuner: doubles a monster's Level for Firewall Saber Dragon.
Cyberse Magician
Ritual: halves your damage and draws attacks and targeting.
Cynet Mining
Discards to search a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.
Cynet Fusion
Fusion Summons Cyberse Clock Dragon, using a Link from the GY.
Cynet Ritual
Ritual Spell for Cyberse Magician; makes two tokens from the GY.
Cynet Backdoor
Banishes a Cyberse to search a weaker one; it returns to attack directly.
Cynet Universe
Field Spell: pumps Links; shuffles a monster from a GY back.
Cynet Circuit
Fills a Firewall Link's zones from the GY; revives a Firewall Link at low LP.
